responsibility: This definition file enumerates the base AArch64 SVE ACLE intrinsic families, excluding the separately listed SVE2 additions. Each DEF_SVE_FUNCTION entry ties an intrinsic base name to a function-shape description, an allowed type-suffix set, predication form rules, and any required architectural extension flags, giving the SVE builtin framework the declarative inventory from which to build overloads, declarations, and expansion mappings.
same_name_distinction: Within the aarch64-sve-builtins-base trio, this is the declarative inventory of base SVE intrinsic families, naming shapes, type sets, predication forms, and required extensions; unlike the .cc file it has no expansion logic, and unlike the .h file it does not declare function_base symbols.
